item.text: {"protocol_version":"wp5-v3","responses":[{"task_id":"risk-01-local-only-files","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"What exact privacy boundary should this feature enforce for file bytes, file metadata, derived text, AI processing, and telemetry?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Add local-only file processing with a strict on-device privacy boundary.","T":"Implement local parsing and processing so file bytes, metadata, and derived text never leave the device, and disable any AI or telemetry paths that would transmit them.","S":"Use the existing on-device parser for the primary format; replace current remote derived-text handling for this flow; exclude cloud AI, remote fallbacks, and telemetry payload excerpts for processed files.","V":"Verify processed files complete without network transmission of bytes, metadata, or derived text; confirm telemetry excludes related payload excerpts; confirm primary-format files are handled by the on-device parser.","X":"Stop if a required file type lacks on-device support, or if any required product behavior still depends on remote AI or telemetry export.","P":"Persist through implementation design for the smallest verifiable slice: primary-format local-only processing first, with outbound paths blocked for that flow.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"risk-02-refund-authority","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"What refund authority should support agents have, including any approval threshold and required audit fields?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":false},{"question":"Should support be allowed to issue partial refunds as well as full refunds within that authority?","scripted_answer_index":1,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Let support agents issue bounded customer refunds safely.","T":"Grant support agents permission to create refunds up to $100 with a required reason, support full and partial refunds within that limit, and require owner approval for larger refunds.","S":"Cover role/permission changes, refund initiation via the payment provider API, required reason capture, owner-gated escalation above $100, and audit-event creation; exclude broader billing-role redesign.","V":"Verify support can create full and partial refunds up to $100, attempts above $100 are blocked pending owner action, reasons are required, and audit events are recorded for each refund path.","X":"Stop if owner approval cannot be enforced, audit logging cannot be added, or payment-provider constraints prevent bounded partial/full refunds as specified.","P":"Persist to the smallest safe slice: permissioning, threshold checks, reason capture, provider call wiring, and audit logging for refund actions.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"risk-03-data-retention","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"What retention outcome do you want for uploads and related report data, including the trigger for when deletion timing starts?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":false},{"question":"How should user-facing deletion semantics work given backups retain objects for 30 days after primary deletion?","scripted_answer_index":1,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Automatically clean up old customer uploads under a defined retention policy.","T":"Delete uploads 90 days after their last report finishes, retain report summaries, and present deletion to users as final even though disaster-recovery backups age out later.","S":"Cover retention policy enforcement for uploads tied to completed reports, preservation of report summaries, scheduling/deletion logic, and user-facing messaging; exclude backup-system redesign.","V":"Verify uploads become eligible 90 days after the last related report completes, summaries remain available, primary objects are deleted on schedule, and user messaging states deletion is final.","X":"Stop if report completion timestamps cannot reliably anchor retention, if summary retention depends on upload objects, or if legal/compliance review rejects the stated user-facing deletion semantics.","P":"Persist with the smallest verifiable slice: eligibility calculation, deletion workflow for primary storage, preserved summaries, and aligned user-facing copy about final deletion.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true}]}
